'''Raikon''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who held the rank of [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa's]] military forces. Commander Raikon was stationed at a [[Tent/Legends|tent]] erected outside [[Wardpost Landa]] in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan's]] [[Juran Mountains/Legends|Juran Mountains]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="Juran Mountains" />
